- By Phone - You can call WASD customer service at 305-665-7477 to make a payment over the phone.

- By Mail - You can mail your payment to the address listed on your water bill statement.

- In Person - You can pay in person at the WASD Customer Service Center located at 3071 SW 38th Ave, Miami, FL 33146.

The City of Doral bills for stormwater services through WASD, so your water and stormwater charges will be on the same bill. The stormwater fee is $4 per month for residential and $4 per 1,548 sq ft of impervious area for commercial properties.

If you have any other questions about your water or stormwater bill, you can contact the WASD customer service team at the number I provided or the City's Public Works Department at 305-593-6740.
